title: Expected length of a SIRSN spanning subnetwork
exact_target: Does the whole network joining uniformly sampled points in an expanding square have expected length asymptotic to its intensity times the square area?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, \emph{UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems}, record 9700035 (AMR-096-0035). CC BY 4.0.
David J. Aldous, \emph{Scale-Invariant Random Spatial Networks}, arXiv:1204.0817v1 (2012), Section 8.4.3, Open Problem 35, p. 50.
